body:
How can I stop and just be calm,

When there is so much going on?

In this world of war and hunger,

I keep asking what my younger

Self could ever have done better,

How I might have shaped this matter

How to give, and contribute

To a world I pay tribute.



To all those who have built this life,

How many times they had to strive.

For us now, it all seems easy,

We have it all, it all feels breezy.

But is it truth, or do we lie?

Sometimes it's hard to even try

To see things clearly, to define

What’s truly yours and what is mine.



And I am confused, I often feel lost,

I want to live - but at what cost?

If others suffer for my earning,

Can I call it life, while all is burning?

I see myself at a crossroad, torn,

Retreating into survival, worn -

Overwhelmed and disappointed,

My soul feels shattered and disjointed.
